metadata.name: gct-mobile-embedded-regression
metadata.description: Stateful layout gate for GCT-MOBILE-001 through GCT-MOBILE-006. It asserts mobile chrome colour agreement and Changes → Diff → Changes geometry (nav within viewport, header not overlapping content, geometry restored) without mutating repository state. Requires observed nonzero phone insets and verifies nav descendants, hit targets, single-inset spacing and menu/Settings canvas restoration. Chromium only; synthetic standalone geometry is not physical installed-app qualification. Header controls must fit a 44–48px row below the status inset.

metadata.label: Open Git Control Tower mobile workspace

assert.failure_message: GCT-MOBILE-006: mobile navigation is not visible in the initial viewport

metadata.label: Capture root, header, nav, and Changes geometry

evaluate.expression: (() => { const pick = (id) => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="' + id + '"]'); if (!el) return null; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return { top:r.top, bottom:r.bottom, height:r.height, scrollTop:el.scrollTop, scrollHeight:el.scrollHeight, clientHeight:el.clientHeight }; }; const scroll = document.querySelector('[data-testid=changes-scroll-region] [data-radix-scroll-area-viewport]') || document.querySelector('[data-testid=changes-scroll-region]'); const scrollRect = scroll?.getBoundingClientRect(); const result = { viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight}, root:pick('git-control-tower'), header:pick('mobile-header'), nav:pick('mobile-nav'), changes:pick('file-list-panel'), changesScroll:scroll ? {top:scrollRect.top,bottom:scrollRect.bottom,scrollTop:scroll.scrollTop,scrollHeight:scroll.scrollHeight,clientHeight:scroll.clientHeight} : null }; const navInView = Boolean(result.nav && result.nav.top >= 0 && result.nav.bottom <= result.viewport.height + 1); const noOverlap = Boolean(result.header && result.changesScroll && result.header.bottom <= result.changesScroll.top + 1); document.body.dataset.gctHeaderCompact = result.header && result.header.height >= 44 && result.header.height <= 48 ? 'true' : 'false'; document.body.dataset.gctNavInViewport = navInView ? 'true' : 'false'; document.body.dataset.gctNoHeaderOverlap = noOverlap ? 'true' : 'false'; return result; })()

metadata.label: Bottom navigation stays within the viewport

assert.failure_message: GCT-MOBILE-006: bottom navigation must sit fully within the viewport (no safe-area overflow below the fold)

metadata.label: Header does not overlap the Changes scroll region

assert.failure_message: GCT-MOBILE-001: the mobile header must not overlap the owned Changes scroll region

metadata.label: Scroll the owned Changes region before tab transition

evaluate.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=changes-scroll-region] [data-radix-scroll-area-viewport]') || document.querySelector('[data-testid=changes-scroll-region]'); if (!el) return {missing:true}; const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight, 240)); el.scrollTo({top:target}); return new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve({scrollTop:el.scrollTop,scrollHeight:el.scrollHeight,clientHeight:el.clientHeight}))); })()

metadata.label: Capture declared and rendered chrome colors

evaluate.expression: (() => { const fill = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid=status-bar-fill]')).backgroundColor; const header = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid=mobile-header]')).backgroundColor; const meta = (document.querySelector('meta[name=theme-color]')?.getAttribute('content') || '').trim().toLowerCase(); const hex = meta.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{6})$/); const metaRGB = hex ? 'rgb(' + parseInt(hex[1].slice(0,2),16) + ', ' + parseInt(hex[1].slice(2,4),16) + ', ' + parseInt(hex[1].slice(4,6),16) + ')' : ''; const normalize = (value) => value.replace(/\s+/g, '').replace(/^rgba\(([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+),1\)$/, 'rgb($1,$2,$3)'); const ok = Boolean(fill && header && metaRGB && normalize(fill) === normalize(header) && normalize(fill) === normalize(metaRGB)); document.body.dataset.gctChromeColors = ok ? 'true' : 'false'; return { fill, header, meta, metaRGB, ok }; })()

metadata.label: Declared and rendered chrome colors agree

assert.failure_message: GCT-MOBILE-002: status-bar fill, header, and theme-color must resolve to the same color
GCT-MOBILE-003: Diff transition did not complete

metadata.label: Capture Changes geometry after tab restoration

evaluate.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=file-list-panel]'); const nav = document.querySelector('[data-testid=mobile-nav]'); const scroll = document.querySelector('[data-testid=changes-scroll-region] [data-radix-scroll-area-viewport]') || document.querySelector('[data-testid=changes-scroll-region]'); if (!el || !nav || !scroll) { document.body.dataset.gctGeometryRestored = 'false'; return { missing:true }; } const panel = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const bottomNav = nav.getBoundingClientRect(); const result = { changes:{top:panel.top,bottom:panel.bottom}, changesScroll:{scrollTop:scroll.scrollTop,scrollHeight:scroll.scrollHeight,clientHeight:scroll.clientHeight}, nav:{top:bottomNav.top,bottom:bottomNav.bottom}, viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight} }; const restored = Boolean(result.nav.top >= 0 && result.nav.bottom <= result.viewport.height + 1 && result.changes.top < result.viewport.height && result.changes.bottom > 0); document.body.dataset.gctGeometryRestored = restored ? 'true' : 'false'; return result; })()

metadata.label: Changes panel and nav remain within the viewport after the tab round-trip

assert.failure_message: GCT-MOBILE-004: after Changes → Diff → Changes, the Changes panel and bottom nav must remain within the viewport
Nonzero phone insets required; nav controls must be unclipped, compact, hit-testable, and reserve the bottom inset exactly once.
Open menu must paint both page canvases to match its bottom surface.
Settings drawer must reach the bottom edge and reserve its safe area in its footer only.
Closing the drawer must restore the compact navigation and original page canvas.

metadata.label: Replay client-observed 793px report with 852px CSS canvas

assert.failure_message: Observed installed geometry must fill the measured 852px canvas and reserve the 34px home-indicator inset exactly once.
Drawer must fill the same 852px measured canvas, with one 34px footer inset and matching body/panel paint.
Installed navigation and canvas must restore without adding safe-area space.

metadata.label: Header reserves the status inset once and uses a compact toolbar row

assert.failure_message: Mobile header must be 44–48px high below the separate status inset; remove excess vertical padding.
